row.body: I saved the cloth with a sweet chemical smell for you. The water-treatment trial crew passed Thursday after closing; the rats left the shed, and afterward the clinic stopped answering.
row.title: Thursday after closing — a sweet chemical smell

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a sweet chemical smell while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
